title: Establishment of a Raman microsphere-based immunochromatographic method for the combined detection of influenza A and B viruses and SARS-CoV-2 antigen on a single T-line
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37498-37511
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05483K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aolin Zhu, Binbin Zhao, Jiutong Li, Xinxia Li, Qian Shi, Xin Zhang, Dongmei Lu, Dong Yan
A simple and rapid method based on Raman microsphere immunochromatography was developed in this study for the simultaneous detection of influenza A and B viruses and SARS-CoV-2 on a single test T-line.
